docs.bodySnippet: [Transcript of the meeting video — Public Services Committee 09-17-24] Context/Agenda: # Public Services Committee 09-17-24 Context/Agenda: it's okay Tom still working the crowd working the crowd good afternoon welcome to the uh no September 17 2024 Public Services Committee meeting uh little housekeeping if you're going to speak please approach Podium turn it on identify yourself if you have a cell phone please turn it off or mute it first item number 14 ordinance second reading amending the unified development code UDC of the city of Cheyenne Wyoming to create PP business park zone district and making conforming amendments to locations throughout the UDC referencing Zone districts and amending the UDC to correct references associated with the SS Support Services District staff report Mr chair members of the committee my name is Seth lyd I'm with the city of cheyen Planning and Development Department um what's before you today is the uh business park zone District the creation of the business park zone District um we had a work session on this a few weeks ago um there wasn't too much feedback from the council at that time and we also had a Planning Commission meeting on this uh last week um at the Planning Commission meeting there was some discussion about possibly changing the minimum acreage for the BP Zone District but otherwise the Planning Commission um recommended approval of this as uh presented um so um I mean that's the final recommendation they had some discussion but the final recommendation was to approve it as presented so there isn't really much changes from the work session but I'll go go over just a a brief overview of the business park zone District so we know what we're doing here or any members of the public who may have not um viewed that work session maybe informed as well the concept here is to provide a Zone district for the exterior portions of the community um close to major transportation corridors that often include a large um level of industry and Commercial businesses um and to create some flexibility there and also make it so we're not consistently changing the Zone in that business park specifically this is um for the north range Business Park annexation which is um on the docket as it were we've already passed the resolution to initiate that and we have we but we still need to pass the ordinance um so it will apply to that area but just looking at some of our business parks in the city already you can see that we have a mix of CB zoning or Li zoning or hi zoning um in the case Context/Agenda: all right well welcome to the City of Cheyenne Council work session for August 9th 2024 today we have a presentation on the 8th Avenue Airport terminal and updates on that and uh with introductions we have director Brad Shaw and you want to introduce who you have with you today sure can you hear me okay okay good afternoon thanks for the opportunity to be here today my name is Tim Bradshaw and I have the honor and privilege of serving as the Director of Aviation for the shyen Regional Airport uh I'm joined by two people today that are very instrumental in getting this project going U to my right is deser brothy which I think most of you are familiar with in different roles and and doing projects around the city and then one person you may not know is Sheryl Bean to my left Cheryl uh retired from the Wyoming Department of Aeronautics last year but she hasn't really retired she's continuing to run full speed uh when I first got here a little over two and a half years ago she was the one of the first people that came to me about the about the building and really wanted to see us try to preserve it and save that building so we've brought her on as uh to help secure grants and do some other work and trying to get that terminal going so uh I'll jump right in if you would like so so do a lot of you recognize that building on the left the 1929 terminal it's a great building uh I've been told by Mike hassle who's also on our steering committee that Amilia Airhart stayed there uh it's quite a sign building it's currently occupied by Wyoming Department of Aeronautics New York Life and the wyomi banking Association and then of course the 1960s terminal and I could almost bet my last dollar that each of you have had some opportunity to be in that building when it was operational and it's quite a unique building when I came over here two and a half years ago a lot of people said we should tear it down uh and then since I've been here I've learned a lot of people in the community like to see us preserve it it's a it's quite a unique building it's the sh of course the shape is what draws everybody's attention to it but but its location everything about it and it's still in pretty good shape but we're we've got a a a momentous task in front of us a Monumental task in front of us to try to get this building preserved and we can't do docs.bodySnippet: [Transcript of the meeting video — City Council Meeting 07-05-24] Context/Agenda: # City Council Meeting 07-05-24 Context/Agenda: good evening ladies and gentlemen I'd like to call the July 8th meeting over the governing body to order Madame clerk would you take the role Mr White present Dr. Aldrich present mayor Collins present Mr cook here Mr escabel here Mr Johnson present Mr lebor pres Dr. Rinne present Mr Royal and Councilman Segrave present one member is absent mayor we do have a quorum would you all join me in the Pledge of Allegiance I pledge allegiance to the flag of the United States of America and to the Republic for which it stands one nation under God indivisible with liberty and justice for all next item is number four consent agenda all agenda items listed with the designation of CA are considered to be routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion there will be no separate discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so request and support by two other members is received any item removed from the consent agenda will be considered in its normal sequence on the agenda all right is there any item a member this governing body would like to remove from the consent agenda hearing none I would entertain a motion so second Councilman Segrave second by Mr escabel all those in favor of the consent agenda please signify by saying "Aye." Aye. those opposed no the consent agenda is approved with Mr Johnson voting no next item is number six ORD ordinance on third reading amending the official zoning map of the city of Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from mub mixed use business to CB community business for land located Northeast of the intersection of cheyen street and Ridge Road all right this is an owner in iated zone change for 4.07 Acres that would U be a better fit for a new car wash and so at this time are there anybody in the audience that would like to speak to this zone change before us hearing none Mr Dr reny Mr Mayor the recommendation of the public service committee is to approve on third and final reading and I would so move it's been second by Councilman Segrave are there comments for members of the governing body hearing none Madam CLK would you take the vote Councilman Segrave yes Mr White yes Dr. Aldrich yes mayor Collins yes Mr cook yes Mr escabel I Mr Johnson yes Mr laybor I and Dr. Rinne yes this ordinance is approved on third and final reading next item is number seven ordinance on second reading amending section 10.16.18 parking violation hearings and appeal procedures of the municipal code of the city of Cheyenne Wyoming modifying the procedures governing the administrative review of parking citations making conforming amendments and repealing an obsolete provision all right this is an ordinance that changed the review and the appeal process for parking tickets is there anybody in the audience that would like to speak to that nobody here gets parking tickets right all right hearing none Dr reny Mr Mayor the recommendation of the public service committee is to approve on second reading and I would so move second it's been seconded by Councilman Segrave comments fro

till the light turns red and then identify yourself and first item number 15 ordinance third reading amending chapter 5.78 Towing and record recovery operations of Title 5 business licenses and regulations of the municipal code of the city of Cheyenne Wyoming modifying Provisions governing Towing and record operation recovery operation ler and the police department's Towing and record recovery operation rotation list hey we have a staff report Mr chairman members of the committee Lieutenant Dan longshine Police Department um would say no iess I guess there was a proposed substitute but no no changes uh from when this was last before the committee uh two weeks ago as far as this ordinance okay any questions from committee questions from committee thank you any public comment okay Richard Johnson 612 McGovern Avenue um on this uh I requested um uh John Brodie to look into this after a comment I made on Council after we had heard um discussion from the tow truck drivers where um in regards to the fee schedule that was uh put in place under resolution that I had asked them if they were okay putting into ordinance that we would uh put it into code that every four years there would be a requirement to actually evaluate the schedule if it was currently working as designed at the current rates if there was a need for an increase rate and you know beneficial if there was actually to be a decrease in the rate that it would actually put into the code now that we would uh be required every four years to kind of look into this uh fee chart and so uh John has the specific language so I'll let him continue on because he was the one that drafted that sentence okay Mr chairman John Brodie WC the attorney um it's a real modest change Mr chairman if you go to the document and uh flip to page 11 uh this is on the redline copy um what I've done is just added some verbiage into subsection F that States during calendar year 2028 and every four years thereafter the governing body shall review and re-evaluate the feast schedule required under this subsection to determine if any changes are appropriate um so that's the gist of the change uh just for the purpose of making the provision a little bit easier to read I then divided out the remainder of that subsection into a new um its own subsection which talks about the authority of the police department to um allow costs in excess um of the fee schedule for good cause so happy to answer any questions okay so any qu Let's uh let me get a motion on the main motion and then when we go to the substitute we'll discuss questions on that okay so any further public comment on the meain okay hearing none Mr chair I move to approval on third reading second I have a motion in a second from Dr. Rinne okay um make a motion to amend Mr chair I'd move to amend by

your V virtual hand to be acknowledged um if are here in um person please make sure you turn your cell phones to manners mode um to make public comment please um use the oh sorry we said that ask if you'll identify yourselves if you're here to do a staff report or would like to make a public comment on an item um no additional business will be discussed following completion of the agenda so with that um Jennifer if you'll read the first item number 14 ordinance third reading approving and establishing revised Water and Sewer rates tap and system development fees administrative fees service charges and penalties and septic and Commercial waste stump rates as recommended by the Board of Public Utilities chairwoman and committee Brad bow Finance man or Administration manager sh Board of Public Utilities in front of you is our annual rate increase it is a 10% increase on the water side 8% increase on the sewer side there have been no changes since last committee meeting the one thing that we would ask is that related to the affordable housing recommendation we would ask that instead of making a change at this time we' request that you'd allow us time to talk this out as it probably has bigger implications than just the affordable housing's request thank you are there any questions for staff yes councilman cook I guess Madam chair through you in in response to that so the way I'm the way I'm hearing that is you would prefer any change come if we choose to make a change at at next Monday's meeting to give you a little extra time is that that's what I'm hearing you say that is what we're requesting we're scared that if a if a recommendation to follow the recommendation from the affordable housing task force we feel like it have bigger implications going through related to other people who pay system development fees that could have Community ramifications that just just it's a bigger issue than just removing a line in that Exhibit C uh followup Madam chair so just just time to do your due diligence correct that's fair hey councilman Johnson so my understanding because I did appreciate that you guys sent the email in regards to this I wasn't thinking by next Monday I thought you guys would actually take the next year to actually do it where everybody from the affordable housing task force Planning Development booo all the parties involved would basically you know this time it would go through as written you know with any other amendments that we've passed up to this point and then you guys would continue to work on it over the next fiscal year councilman Johnson that is correct we were we did we didn't quite have the read of the room so we wanted to make sure that we were addressing it promptly versus have it hit us and not be able to react any other questions for staff hey
